serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Thank you very much~ I will go deliver the good news now. 
Landlord: Should I tell them who gave me this money?
You: No. I don’t want people to know that I’m stacked. It’s enough for me that you know about it.
Landlord: Reasonable. {{wi}}Kinda weird coming from your mouth.
Landlord: Don’t worry, your secret is safe with me. I could snitch to the cops, but I would never snitch to the IRS. Fuck these guys.
You: Thanks{{wi}}, I guess.
Landlord: See you later buddy.
You: Bye.
What is this guy thinking? Would he really just kick them out? Even I’m not that heartless.
Some things he said… made me sick. He has a daughter too, can’t he put himself in their place?
I really want to limit my interaction with this man…
